job.purpose: R4b native ETM (CTS placement-RC): 22 launch fails command[18..31]/command_v/ordinal 220.6..250.8 > 220 ps. Cause: clk pin on the N face WEST half (top:4-107) and command pins at the BOTTOM of the E face (right:4-66): the output launch flops sit in the leaf corner farthest from the clock entry (command clk 221..256, mean 250 vs boundary mean R 226.7). Structural pin-geometry fix: clk to the N face EAST half, output pins ordered so command/command_v/ordinal occupy the TOP of the E face next to the clock entry; inputs (capture margin 57 ps) take the later clock. No RTL, cycle or threshold change; same 220.32x129.6 outline and macro location. The r4 command pad-trio removal hook is dropped (it breaks OT_ANCHOR_PACK: 'recorded anchor is not one actual FIRM standard cell ot_ohdrv_00001_0'); all outputs keep the standard FF-hold trio.
